analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: We disclose information within Verizon including with our affiliates; with service providers who perform work on our behalf; and with others as described in this policy including for fraud prevention, directory assistance, legal compliance, credit and collections, caller id, and certain advertising purposes.

analysis.headline: Shares for Personalized Ads
analysis.quote: We have optional programs that allow Verizon and third parties to show you advertisements that are more personalized and useful to you or to help third parties verify your identity.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Wireless Location
analysis.quote: We also collect information about how our network and your devices are working, including the location of your wireless devices.

analysis.headline: Gets Your Info From Others
analysis.quote: We also obtain information about you from other companies, such as credit, demographic and interest information.

analysis.headline: Limited Data Deletion Rights
analysis.quote: You can also access and update information we have about you and delete certain information we have.

analysis.headline: Specific State Law Rights
analysis.quote: You may have additional rights under the Cable Act and state laws, including California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia and Washington privacy laws.

analysis.headline: Uses Your De-identified Insights
analysis.quote: Another program develops insights by analyzing de-identified customer information and reporting on aggregate behaviors.

analysis.headline: Responds To Government Demands
analysis.quote: Our Transparency Report provides information about data requests we receive.
